zoe_marketing: Quick ask for the webinar slides + blog: can runtime validate two short benchmark claims and hand over a tiny reproducible bundle? Specifically: (A) per-token cost delta for rwd-gen4-small-quant vs rwd-gen4-small-fp16 for single-request UX, (B) p95 coldstart latency numbers. Keep payloads <=128 tokens.

priya_bench: Yep. We'll run single-request (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1 hosted and produce p50/p95/p99 latency CSVs, token-cost estimate, and a small repro tarball (payloads + run script + Dockerfile). ETA: 4 hours.

zoe_marketing: Sweet. Also need a laptop-friendly demo command we can paste into the speaker notes (no cloud autoscaler).

nate_runtime: We'll include both cloud and local commands. Local will use the Docker image we ship for bench: redwood/bench:latest and point to a local proxy to avoid autoscaler variance. Example we plan to provide:
```bash
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY \
  -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:latest \
  /app/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant \
    --endpoint http://localhost:8080/v1/generate --payloads /app/payloads/demo.json \
    --warmup 20 --duration 30 --concurrency 1
```

priya_bench: benchbot: job 1807660005 queued (tags: webinar, short-run). We'll attach bench_artifact_id in the bundle metadata. Note: hosted coldstart can vary if a scale-up happens; we'll include a one-line caveat you can paste under the slide.

zoe_marketing: Nice. Can you also include the raw trace id for any outliers so we can decide whether to call them out?

priya_bench: Sure. If a spike appears we'll include trace ids and a condensed trace snippet. If nothing odd, we'll note "no notable outliers in our runs".

ops-bot: reminder: for public claims cite measurement conditions: batch=1, concurrency=1, region=us-west1, payloads <=128 tokens. See runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/bench-claims

priya_bench: Uploaded artifacts -> s3://bench-outputs/marketing/1807660005/ (contains csv, traces, demo.tar.gz, README). bench_artifact_id: 1807660005. One-line caveat: "Measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; results depend on workload and deployment mode."

zoe_marketing: Perfect. We'll wire the S3 link into the slide notes and use the caveat. Thanks team! :rocket:
